name: OpenVibe.Games

site.name: Games
site.tagline: Browser games, and games you make
site.what: Scraplandia, Salvage Rush and other multiplayer games that run in a tab and keep your progress. Make your own: build a world in the map editor with a team, remix anyone's, use builds other creators share, play it first-person or top-down, and publish it for anyone to join.

faq.question: Do I need to install anything?
faq.answer: No. Scraplandia, Salvage Rush, Vibe Heroes and the rest run in a browser tab and know your OpenVibe account.

faq.question: Can I build my own world?
faq.answer: Yes. Any account can make up to five worlds. Each starts on flat ground you can sculpt in the map editor; invite up to eight people to build it with you, place builds and scripts other creators share in the asset store, choose first-person or top-down, and publish it for anyone to join from a browser. Others can remix it into their own, with your name on it.

faq.question: Is my progress saved?
faq.answer: Yes. Leaderboards, achievements and cloud saves come from OpenVibe.Play, so your progress follows your account.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; liveness only (the ov_games PostgreSQL database and the simulation tick are what /api/ready checks)

drains: stops taking connections and WebSocket upgrades (503); requests in flight carry on, answered with Connection: close
simulation tick, metrics and outbox-prune timers, editor lock sweeper and media mirror stopped
every player told the server is restarting, then every game and editor socket closed with 1012 (service restart); each game close saves that character and records games.player.left
a socket that has not finished the close handshake after 3 s is terminated
world saved: every session marked dirty and flushed (game.shutdown)
requests in flight finish (5 s at most, then cut)
the media mirror's pass in progress (2 s at most), the progress-summary writes (1 s) and the outbox's last send (2 s) awaited; unsent rows stay in the outbox
the ov_games PostgreSQL database closed, physics disposed, exit 0
shutdown.note: clients reconnect on their own after 1012; the whole stop is bounded at 10 s (exit 1 past it), inside the unit's TimeoutStopSec=30

resumes.what: the world is restored from the ov_games PostgreSQL database before the network opens (schema migrated forward first)
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)
the media mirror backfills what it has not uploaded yet, then keeps mirroring
players reconnect; characters were saved on shutdown

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy games (strategy pnpm-build) restores the previous sha, rebuilds and restarts when the ready URL does not answer 2xx after the restart
manual: sudo ovhost rollback games --to <sha> (rebuilds the workspace)
rollback.window: as long as the ov_games PostgreSQL database has not been migrated past the older build's SCHEMA_VERSION
blockers: a build refuses the ov_games PostgreSQL database whose meta.schema_version is newer than its own (SCHEMA_VERSION 13 today, forward-only migrations): going back past a schema bump fails at boot

leases.none: no claims: one process owns the ov_games PostgreSQL database; writes are transactions there

notes: Scraplandia (browser runtime). Players are keyed by canonical Network subjects (ADR-0006 in the repo). Calls Events (events.event.publish), Media (media.object.upload, namespace games: map-editor assets) and Network identity (identity.subject.resolve, batch legacy adoption) with the games client-credentials principal. Mods: games-content@1 declarative packs only; executable mods wait for OpenVibe.Host Stage C. No achievement system exists, so there are no games.achievement.* events.
